News CategoryAlertMarketsWhat You Need To Know
Data Technical News#2026-016The Nasdaq Stock Market

On August 11, 2026, Collective Mining Ltd (NYSE American: CNL) is expected to be listed and begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Market under the same ticker symbol CNL.

Nasdaq requests that market data redistributors update their databases to reflect the new listing market for Collective Mining Ltd. after market close on August 10, 2026, and maintain historical data for CNL prior to transfer date.

title: IEX Options CRD Registrations
raw_text:
IEX Options CRD Registrations
Category: Regulatory; Alert 2026-013
Overview Effective September 26, 2026, the following registration categories will be added to the Form U4 in FINRA’s Central Registration Depository (CRD) for IEX Exchange: OP = Options Principal, Series 4 SU = General Securities Sales Supervisor, Series 9/10 FINRA will automatically register qualified personnel in applicable registration categories (OP or SU) for IEX Options Members. No additional action will be required for these Members. Note: entitled users may add or terminate the OP and SU registration categories via the FINRA Gateway at any time. FINRA Gateway and Entitlements Members must use their current FINRA entitlement user ID and password to access the FINRA Gateway . Questions regarding access to the FINRA Gateway should be directed to your firm’s Super Account Administrator (SAA). For additional support, contact the FINRA Support Center at (301) 869-6699. Contact Information Please contact IEX Options Market Operations with any questions: Options Market Operations: optionsmktops@iextrading.com About The Investors Exchange Investors’ Exchange LLC (IEX Exchange) is a national securities exchange designed to provide superior execution quality and set a new standard for trading. Since launching in 2016, the exchange has grown to be one of the largest exchange operators globally, by notional value traded. In 2026, IEX plans to launch IEX Options, a new U.S. options exchange that will bring its suite of order protection innovations designed to better address the needs of market makers and drive better outcomes for end investors. To learn more visit iex.io .
